cases.sentence: Я всегда буду петь о ___ Господа.
cases.translation: I will always sing about the Lord's mercy.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Ты сказал, с избранным Моим заключил я ___.
cases.translation: You said, I have made a covenant with My chosen one.
cases.explain: The verb заключил (made) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Небеса прославляют Твои чудеса, Господи, и Твою верность в собрании ___.
cases.translation: The heavens praise Your wonders, Lord, and Your faithfulness in the assembly of the holy ones.
cases.explain: The preposition в with 'собрании' governs the genitive case for the adjective.

cases.translation: You rule over the rage of the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты основал вселенную и всё, что её наполняет, ___ и юг ты сотворил.
cases.translation: You have established the universe and all that fills it; north and south You have created.
cases.explain: The verb сотворил (created) takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession or relationship between nouns.

cases.sentence: От Господа щит наш, от святого Израиля ___ наш.
cases.translation: Our shield is from the Lord, our king is from the Holy One of Israel.
cases.explain: After the preposition от and the copula, the predicate nominative uses the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я нашел Давида, моего ___, и моим святым маслом помазал его.
cases.translation: I have found David, My servant, and anointed him with My holy oil.
cases.explain: The verb нашел (found) takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Я всегда буду петь о милости Господа.
reading.question: What does the psalmist commit to do always?
reading.explain: Я всегда буду петь о милости Господа — I will always sing about the Lord's mercy.

reading.ru: Ты сказал, с избранным Моим заключил я завет, с Давидом Моим слугой.
reading.question: With whom did God make a covenant?
options: With His chosen one, David His servant
reading.correct: With His chosen one, David His servant
reading.explain: Ты сказал, с избранным Моим заключил я завет, с Давидом Моим слугой — You said, I have made a covenant with My chosen one, with David My servant.

reading.ru: Кто на небесах сравнится с Господом? Кто из сынов властителей уподобится Господу?
reading.question: To whom does the psalmist compare God?
options: To no one - God is incomparable
reading.correct: To no one - God is incomparable
reading.explain: The rhetorical questions кто сравнится? implies no one can be compared to God.

reading.ru: Ты владычествуешь над яростью моря. Когда волны вздымаются, ты укращаешь их.
reading.question: What power does God have over the sea?
options: He rules over its rage and calms the waves
He is afraid of the sea
reading.correct: He rules over its rage and calms the waves
reading.explain: Ты владычествуешь над яростью моря ... укращаешь их — You rule over the rage of the sea and calm the waves.

reading.ru: Я нашел Давида, моего слугу, и моим святым маслом помазал его.
reading.question: What did God do for David?
options: Found him and anointed him with holy oil
reading.correct: Found him and anointed him with holy oil
reading.explain: Я нашел Давида и моим святым маслом помазал его — I found David and anointed him with My holy oil.

reading.ru: Навек сохраню милость свою к нему, и завет мой с ним твердым будет.
reading.question: What promise does God make to David?
options: He will keep His mercy forever and His covenant will remain firm
reading.correct: He will keep His mercy forever and His covenant will remain firm
reading.explain: Навек сохраню милость ... и завет ... твердым будет — I will keep My mercy forever and My covenant will be firm.
